text: Set up and design are very beautiful. Had to change rooms due to aircon not working, sent engineers up and they said it would work, so I waited an hour. Second room I went to, the curtain was broken. Terrible night sleep. * 1 night · September 2026 * Solo traveller

The hotel is beautiful and the service was generally outstanding. However I had fully prepaid before arrival, was asked for a security deposit, and confirmed no further amount should be charged. About 24 hours later the entire cost of the stay had been charged to my card again without authorisation, effectively charging me twice. When I raised it the transaction was reversed, but the response was simply that it was a mistake. It raises a question about payment controls and whether the duplicate charge would have been found had I not noticed it myself. * 3 nights · August 2026 * Family

We did not feel that some of the staff cared about the guests. It felt learned and merely polite. The weakest Mandarin Oriental we have experienced, and this was our fourth. Management even ignored relatively negative feedback. * 5 nights · August 2026 * Family
Nothing. The rooms do not match the photos on the website or the price. Everything is old, dirty, broken. * 2 nights · June 2026 * Solo traveller
The bed and bed linen. Would like a larger bathroom with two sinks, and a more modern smart television. * 6 nights · July 2026 * Family

Very convenient valet parking service. Very kind and helpful staff at the entrance, who gave us extra water supplies on departure. Strategic position in the Museumplein district. The only flaw was the television in the room not working. * 3 nights · August 2026 * Solo traveller

The location was the only thing I really liked. Street noise could clearly be heard inside the room. There were no water bottles by the bed, and even when I called reception to request water it was never delivered. The bathroom doors were very difficult to push open and block the hallway. Reception service was very slow, the phone could ring for around five minutes before someone answered. The room-cleaning light was not working, I reported it but it was never fixed. At check-out the receptionist asked me to pay the room charge again even though it had been taken from my account two days before arrival. * 2 nights · July 2026 * Couple
You have the best staff in this hotel. The luxury, the calm. * 1 night · May 2026 * Couple
Location. Bathrooms smelled bad. The air conditioning was not cold enough. Early morning staff on Sunday was not very qualified. * 3 nights · July 2026 * Couple

Great location, helpful and attentive staff, comfortable room, excellent restaurant. The elevators had been out of service for three days and the problem still had not been fixed. * 5 nights · July 2026 * Group
The rooms and staff were awesome. * 2 nights · July 2026 * Family
Location. The time before our room was ready. * 2 nights · July 2026 * Solo traveller

We were upgraded on arrival. The room was good, the bed and pillows passable. Having stayed at comparable London hotels many times, sadly it did not come near. All members of staff were super friendly and helpful. There were cracks in the plaster on the walls and scuffed furniture. Food choice in the restaurant was poor, we were forced to dine out. Breakfast passable. * 2 nights · June 2026 * Couple
Staff were super friendly, helpful and efficient. Food options very poor, forced to dine out. * 4 nights · June 2026 * Family
Great location, friendly front desk, great breakfast. Some things not working properly like the shower, bathrooms and the air conditioning system in the room. * 1 night · June 2026 * Couple
The sound system. The bathroom door is very difficult to open, it feels like it will break. * 4 nights · June 2026 * Couple
The staff were very friendly and professional. Beds are comfortable and linens are soft. The building itself is magnificent. * 2 nights · May 2026 * Couple

I booked to celebrate a special occasion and it was one of the most disappointing hotel experiences I have had. The room was spacious and the breakfast buffet was very good quality, but the room felt dated. Before arrival I was invited to share the purpose of my visit and told them I was celebrating a special occasion. This was completely ignored, with no acknowledgement or amenity. I also requested an invoice and received no response. What should have been a routine invoice request turned into four weeks of emails. It took six emails before anyone offered even a simple apology. I was charged twice, given incorrect information at check-out, received incorrect invoices, and had to repeatedly follow up. At one point I received an email intended for another guest with their details. What disappointed me was the lack of ownership and attention to detail in resolving them. * 5 nights · April 2026 * Solo traveller
Location, building. Price versus quality is not in balance versus other hotels, service just okay. * 2 nights · May 2026 * Solo traveller
Location, staff, restaurants. Nothing to fault. * 2 nights · April 2026 * Solo traveller

Location of hotel is great. The room was nicely decorated and laid out. Service was poor, which is surprising as we have stayed previously and it was excellent. I had asked about beds for our children beforehand and never got a reply. They then organised once we got there but it delayed bed time and made things unnecessarily difficult. * 3 nights · April 2026 * Couple

Our assigned room was a sitting area with a loft bedroom and the stairs are steep. We requested a different room and the front desk staff accommodated us with an upgrade to a single floor unit. The upgrade met our expectations. * 1 night · April 2026 * Couple
Position and design. Price. * 1 night · March 2026 * Couple

The only thing I liked was the building and the room. Airport transport announced as included on the booking site was not confirmed by the property. Very long response times, redirection to an external concierge service. Billing error on arrival, double charge on an invoice of 1042 euros, had to go back down for correction. Intrusive intervention in the room, personal effects thrown away by mistake including a sentimental object, with a total inability to manage the situation. The object reappeared unexplained during the night, suggesting staff entered the room while we slept. No consideration or gesture despite the incident. Unclear billing with a high minibar charge without initial detail. * 3 nights · February 2026 * Solo traveller

Location and parking are top. Poor price quality ratio for the rooms, certainly not bad but for that price it could be better. Breakfast was very mediocre. The food in the restaurant was also very disappointing this time. * 2 nights · March 2026 * Solo traveller
The hotel was amazing in terms of facilities and location. The staff was very helpful. Dark corridors. Heavy doors. * 3 nights · March 2026 * Couple
The location is nice. The rooms smell, airless and dusty. * 1 night · February 2026 * Solo traveller

Breakfast was great but the staff were very slow. Every order was repeated and took at least twenty minutes. They forgot about my birthday and were very slow in service. * 2 nights · February 2026 * Couple

Staff did a good job, valet parking on the property, spacious rooms with all facilities. Very pretty interior and excellent location. Breakfast really below standard, not enough space for hotel guests, the offer far too small and the buffet was not replenished in time. Had to wait half an hour for three eggs sunny side up and coffee and tea. And all that for 52 euros per person. * 1 night · February 2026 * Solo traveller

Because the room I reserved was not available they had to upgrade me to a much larger and more comfortable room. I did not like the accommodation they were going to give me, which was omitted in the booking that it would be a room on two floors, making mobility terrible. * 1 night · February 2026 * Couple
The gym, pool, spa, breakfast, Japanese restaurant. Dark room and very old-fashioned service in the hall. * 4 nights · January 2026 * Family

Excellent staff. Televisions in the room not working properly. Stairs to the bedroom are sharp, not able to use bare feet. Elevator door pass activator does not work properly, takes a few times to activate. Bathroom door does not close properly, water on bathroom floor when showering.
